rationale: Provides a concrete district geometry ("Eight grasping tentacles...reach inward to anchor on the ink-dark pupil of Brockton," thread of interstate, contiguity at mean water line) and a fitting animal nickname ("Squid-strict"). It omits the 1812/Elbridge Gerry historical grounding, so not perfect for the bonus.
quote: Eight grasping tentacles of affluent coastal suburbs (Cohasset, Hingham, Duxbury, Marshfield) reach inward to anchor on the ink-dark pupil of Brockton
